ITEM 1 | Large mass of white, opaque, crumbly curd-like pieces with irregular rough surfaces, covering the left half of a square white plate, roughly 1.5 cm chunks with soft, moist-looking edges and no visible sauce or sheen; piled about 2 cm high | 260
ITEM 2 | Cubes of orange-brown roasted vegetable with slightly browned, caramelized edges and dense, firm texture, about 2 cm pieces, clustered in the upper right of the plate next to the fruit | 110
ITEM 3 | Cubes of orange-yellow melon with smooth, slightly glossy flesh and firm edges, about 1.5 cm pieces, scattered on the right side of the plate | 60
ITEM 4 | Cubes of bright red watermelon with juicy, moist surface and crisp edges, about 2 cm pieces, along the lower right of the plate | 70
ITEM 5 | Sliced and cubed strawberry with glossy red surface and slightly seedy texture, one larger halved piece near the center right, about 2 cm, next to melon and watermelon | 25
ITEM 6 | Small whole dark blueberries, deep blue-purple with slight bloom, about 1 cm each, six to seven scattered on the curd and fruit | 15
